theorem lg_target (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = 3 * x + 2) : Function.Injective f := by
  intros x y
  rintro (h : f x = f y)
  rw [hf x, hf y] at h
  have := congr_arg (fun z => z - 2) h
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg] at this
  have := congr_arg (fun z => z / 3) this
  rw [mul_inv'] at this
  exact this
